sources.title: Xiamen University 2026 International Undergraduate Admission Guide

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen, physically and mentally healthy, friendly to China, and hold a valid regular foreign passport.
Hold a high-school diploma or above and be 18 to 30 years old by September 1, 2026. Applicants under 18 must provide the required guardian documents.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants formerly holding Chinese nationality or born abroad to Chinese parents
requirements.ruleText: Meet the guide's nationality-document and overseas-residence rules, including the applicable four-year foreign-passport period and two years of actual overseas residence during the preceding four years.

For Chinese-medium study, humanities, economics, management, law and arts generally require HSK 5 with 210; science, engineering, medicine and physical education generally require HSK 4 with 210. A qualifying prior Chinese-medium education certificate may replace the HSK evidence under the guide.
Apply online from December 1, 2025 through May 10, 2026. Scholarship application deadlines are earlier and follow the corresponding scholarship notice.
Register in the XMU international student application system, complete the application, upload the required records and pay the application fee online.
Submit the passport information page valid through at least October 31, 2026, birth certificate, and identity documents of both parents.
Submit the high-school diploma and complete high-school transcripts. Current students may submit expected-graduation proof but must present the final original diploma at registration.

For Chinese-medium study, humanities, economics, management, law and arts generally require HSK 5 with 210; science, engineering, medicine and physical education generally require HSK 4 with 210. A qualifying prior Chinese-medium education certificate may replace the HSK evidence under the guide.

Submit CSCA Mathematics and Professional Chinese; the guide exempts the Chinese-language major when HSK 4 or above is supplied. Applicants to science, engineering, agriculture and medicine also submit Physics and/or Chemistry. The test language follows the program medium.
Submit one recommendation letter.
Submit a personal statement of at least 800 words in the language of instruction.
A pre-acceptance letter from an XMU academic unit may be submitted when available.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form and its attachments, completed as required and valid for six months.
Submit the financial guarantee statement and supporting financial records. Applying for a scholarship does not waive this document.
Submit a no-criminal-record certificate issued within six months before application.
Submit the portfolio required by the relevant program; other applicants may submit supporting awards or achievement evidence when available.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants whose records are not in Chinese or English
requirements.ruleText: Provide notarized Chinese or English translations. XMU may request original or supplementary records and materials are not returned.
Undergo XMU's comprehensive qualification review and the admitting unit's assessment, which may include a remote interview or written examination.
Pay the non-refundable RMB 400 application fee.

requirements.appliesTo: Enrolled Chinese-medium undergraduate students in this route
requirements.ruleText: Pay annual tuition of RMB 24,000 or 26,000 according to discipline category.
Purchase comprehensive medical insurance at RMB 800 per year.

Budget for campus-dependent accommodation and living costs: published accommodation ranges include RMB 35-65/day at Siming, RMB 1,600-4,000/year at Xiang'an, and RMB 1,100-1,200/year at Zhangzhou; the guide estimates food at RMB 1,000-1,500/month.
